_description:
Sprint 13, build step 7 (plan.md §E.15 step 7: 'commit the 10b situational driver as a set in answer:gate'). The 10b situational-decomposition pairs (`hr-docs/sprints/sprint-10b/eval/situational-decomposition-gold.json`, s1–s5 + the c1/c2 citation-neutrality controls) were previously only run through a throwaway, never-committed `/tmp` script (10b review §3.4). Converted here to a real `answer:gate` fixture — each pair becomes two cases (canonical + situational), run through whichever engine you pass.

  Employee: every case uses `test-navarra@example.com`, the same account 10b's own driver effectively exercised — the original situational-decomposition-gold.json pairs carry no employee/scope field at all, and the 10b review's own environment caveat (§3.4: 'staging currently has zero ingested convenio-scoped chunks for every test employee ... this driver therefore exercises the mechanism entirely within the Estatuto/national_law chunk space') already established that which employee ran these pairs did not change what was being measured. If convenio-scoped chunks exist for `test-navarra@example.com` by the time this runs, the path/authority distribution below simply reports that reality — no case here hard-asserts `authority_used`.

  Deliberately NOT hard-gated on `outcome`: 10b's own finding (review §3.2, id 2 / periodo_prueba's per-claim grounding gate) is that a genuinely correct, on-topic answer can still legitimately escalate `low_confidence` some fraction of the time — that is the per-claim entailment gate working as designed, not a routing miss this fixture should fail on. What IS reported per case: outcome, path, authority_used, and (informationally) whether the answer contains legal-figure vocabulary — the citation-NEUTRALITY claim itself (same chunk-ids/documents with vs. without decomposition) is `Sprint10bInvariantTest`'s own reflection-based proof, already committed and already run every full suite; this fixture proves the pairs are still routable and answerable through the REAL AnswerEngineDispatcher path today (§B.4.4's window/decomposition are on the live production path, not a toggle this fixture flips), not a second copy of 10b's own invariant.

  Run: php artisan answer:gate --engine=classic --set=hr-docs/sprints/sprint-13/eval/situational.json (or --engine=agent/--engine=both). Needs `test-navarra@example.com` seeded (staging:seed-test-users --chat-profiles, or the local equivalent) — an unseeded run reports every case SKIPPED, honestly, rather than fabricating the account.

cases.question: llevo tres meses en la empresa, ¿cuándo dejo de estar a prueba?
¿Cuántos días de vacaciones me corresponden al año?
mi jefe me ha denegado las vacaciones, ¿puede hacerlo?
¿cuánto preaviso tengo que dar si me voy?
quiero dejar la empresa el mes que viene, ¿con cuánto tiempo tengo que avisar?
el próximo lunes es fiesta en mi pueblo pero no en la empresa, ¿tengo que ir a trabajar?
me han hecho quedarme dos horas más ayer, ¿me tienen que pagar algo por eso?
¿Cuántos días de permiso por matrimonio?
cases.note: FIXTURE CORRECTED (CP-2 condition 2): was value_contains '15' (the Estatuto art. 37.1.a statutory figure). test-navarra is on convenio 22 (Limpieza Navarra 2024-2027, doc 36 art. 1 Licencias Retribuidas, p9-11: 'a) Matrimonio: 18 días naturales', verified fact #105); the convenio improves the statutory 15, so 18 is right and 15 was wrong.
